title: Sex-dependent cholesterol and coronary disease: no established incremental prediction across independent angiography centers
abstract: A sex-by-total-cholesterol term added to flexible additive standard predictors changed Cleveland-to-Hungary angiography Brier error by -0.000773 (joint bootstrap95% [-0.012072,0.015597];303 source,269 target). Incremental benefit was not established; a linear additive baseline transported better.
